definition: A run of whole members that a pack's own words name as one division of an assembly, such as the classical wall's pedestal, wall field and entablature. It ends where a member ends, and is stated by the pack, never read off its members.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's zones field, with the classical trim family's Georgian wall as the example. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, zones description: "The divisions a pack's own words give an assembly, each a named run of whole members"; schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, zones description: "Declared ONLY where the pack's own text states the division, never read back off the member heights"; schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, zone name description: "the classical wall's pedestal, wall field and entablature"; proportions/systems/trim-classical.json module.note: "Pedestal 4, wall field 12, entablature 3.".
